findings.title: Load fallback locales for translations outside controller requests
findings.body: Fallback translations are loaded only by this controller filter, while the translation accelerator still loads only `config.locale` when `I18n.t` is called. Background jobs, mailers, and other non-controller callers therefore do not load the site-default and English YAML files before the fallback backend searches them. In a worker where those locales have not already been loaded, missing localized keys still produce missing-translation results instead of the intended fallback. Ensure the fallback chain is loaded in the translation path itself, rather than relying on an HTTP request filter.

findings.title: Include the site fallback locale in the translation cache key
findings.body: The new fallback chain depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but this cache key includes only the translation key, requested locale, and backend identity. If an administrator changes the site's default locale, a cached translation for a key missing from the user's locale continues returning the previous site's fallback-language text until eviction or reload. Include the effective fallback configuration in the cache key or invalidate the cache when it changes.
